title: High glucose levels promote glycolysis and cholesterol synthesis via ERRalpha and suppress the autophagy-lysosomal pathway in endometrial cancer.
authors: Mao, Xiaodan; Huang, Lixiang; Liu, Xianhua; Lin, Xite; Wu, Qibin; Wang, Xinrui; Ren, Yuan; Ma, Jincheng; Zhang, Maotong; Lin, Yao; Ralser, Damian J; Mustea, Alexander; Chen, Gang; Sun, Pengming
one_liner_zh: 该文研究高糖通过ERRalpha促进子宫内膜癌糖酵解与胆固醇合成并抑制自噬，虽含分子动力学模拟蛋白-蛋白互作，但核心非TF-DNA结合，且AI/物理模拟方法仅辅助验证，与课题匹配度低。
abstract: Endometrial cancer (EC) patients with Diabetes Mellitus (DM) always have a poor prognosis. Estrogen-related receptor alpha (ERRalpha) is known as the metabolic-related prognostic factor for EC. However, the mechanism linking glycolipid metabolism dysfunction mediated by ERRalpha to poor prognosis of EC with DM is still unclear. In vitro, high-glucose (HG) levels showed enhancement of ERRalpha expression, cell proliferation, and inhibition of the autophagic lysosomes and apoptosis by flow cytometry analysis, transmission electron microscopy, and CCK-8 assays. Mechanistically, lose-and-gain function assay, DNA sequencing, and CO-IP revealed HG increased ERRalpha expression to promote the transcription of HK2 and HMGCS1, which were the key rate-limiting enzyme of glycolysis-cholesterol synthesis and their metabolites suppressed the autophagy-lysosomal pathway in an ERRalpha-dependent manner. Furthermore, CO-IP and molecular dynamics simulation uncovered the protein residues (ARG 769(HK2) vs. ARG 313(HMGCS1)) of HK2 and HMGCS1 could bind to p62 to form stable protein complexes involved in the autophagy-lysosomal pathway. In EC tissue from patients with comorbid DM, ERRalpha was significantly higher expressed compared to EC tissue from patients without evidence for DM (p < 0.05). The 3D EC organoid model with HG stimulation showed that the cell viability of XCT790 + carboplatin treatment was similar to that of metformin+carboplatin treatment, while the obviously bigger volume of organoids was more visible in the metformin+carboplatin group, indicating the therapy of XCT790 + carboplatin had the better inhibition of EC organoids with the same carboplatin dose. Besides insights into the interaction of HG and the autophagy-lysosomal pathway via ERRalpha, our present study points out the potential benefit of targeting ERRalpha in patients with EC with dysregulation of glucose and cholesterol metabolism.
abstract_zh: 患有糖尿病（DM）的子宫内膜癌（EC）患者预后通常较差。雌激素相关受体α（ERRalpha）被认为是EC的代谢相关预后因子。然而，ERRalpha介导的糖脂代谢紊乱与EC合并DM不良预后之间的关联机制尚不清楚。在体外实验中，通过流式细胞术、透射电子显微镜和CCK-8实验发现，高糖（HG）水平增强了ERRalpha表达和细胞增殖，并抑制了自噬溶酶体和细胞凋亡。机制上，功能缺失与获得实验、DNA测序和CO-IP揭示，HG通过增加ERRalpha表达来促进HK2和HMGCS1的转录，这两种酶是糖酵解-胆固醇合成的关键限速酶，其代谢产物以ERRalpha依赖性方式抑制自噬-溶酶体途径。此外，CO-IP和分子动力学模拟揭示了HK2和HMGCS1的蛋白残基（ARG 769(HK2) 对 ARG 313(HMGCS1)）能够与p62结合，形成参与自噬-溶酶体途径的稳定蛋白复合物。在合并DM的EC患者组织中，ERRalpha的表达显著高于无DM证据的EC患者组织（p < 0.05）。在HG刺激下的3D EC类器官模型中，XCT790 + 卡铂处理的细胞活力与二甲双胍 + 卡铂处理相似，而二甲双胍 + 卡铂组中类器官体积明显更大，表明在相同卡铂剂量下，XCT790 + 卡铂治疗对EC类器官具有更好的抑制作用。除了揭示HG通过ERRalpha与自噬-溶酶体途径的相互作用外，本研究还指出了在糖和胆固醇代谢紊乱的EC患者中靶向ERRalpha的潜在益处。
